data.one_liner: Adds shell command completion support to Dart console apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a wrapper around ArgParser that registers a hidden "completion" command. The package can generate a shell script to enable tab‑completion for the app’s arguments.
use_when: You need tab‑completion for a Dart CLI tool
You already use the args package for argument parsing
avoid_when: You are building a GUI or web app
strengths: Works with the standard args package
weaknesses: No support for custom completion logic beyond args parsing
